crossRefs.note: Moses said, “Now Yahweh will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because…
crossRefs.keyword: whole month. Heb. month of days

crossRefs.note: In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp.
crossRefs.keyword: whole month. Heb. month of days

crossRefs.note: The people spoke against God and against Moses: “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For…
He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.
He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.
A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.
“Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I said indeed that your house and the house of your father should walk…
Now therefore the sword will never depart from your house, because you have despised me, and have taken Uriah the…
“A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master…
‘Behold, you scoffers, and wonder, and perish; for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe…
Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: but a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because you have rejected Yahweh who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?” ’ ”
translations.bsb: but for a whole month—until it comes out of your nostrils and makes you nauseous—because you have rejected the LORD, who is among you, and have cried out before Him, saying, ‘Why did we ever leave Egypt?’”
translations.kjv: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the LORD which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
translations.asv: but a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you; because that ye have rejected Jehovah who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
